audience: small businesses that keep leads, customers and sales records in OneHash

useCases.title: Check the API user behind the key
useCases.text: Read the API user that the key pair belongs to. Use it first to confirm the connection works.

useCases.title: List open leads
useCases.text: List records of a DocType such as Lead, with chosen fields, filters and ordering. Page through the results with a start value.

useCases.title: Read a customer with its linked records
useCases.text: List customers to find a name. Then read one record with all its fields and child tables, and inline the linked records.

useCases.title: Create a customer record
useCases.text: Create a record of a DocType with the field values you give. OneHash rejects the record with a validation error if a required field is missing.

useCases.title: Update the status of a lead
useCases.text: Read one lead, then change some field values of it. Send only the fields to change.
